title: Memberships
description: Who is a member, what they get, and whose membership ends soon.
resumed: Membership started again. The paused time was added on.
cancelDescription: It can still be used until {expires}, and won't renew.
cancelReasonHelp: Members often call later to ask why.
emptyMessage: Sell a membership at the counter, or from a customer's page.
tiersDescription: What you sell, its price, and what members get.
noTiersMessage: A plan is what people buy: its price, how long it lasts, and what they get.
tierArchived: {name} is no longer sold. Current members keep what they have.
archiveMessage: It can't be bought any more. {count} current memberships run until they end.
tierEditorDescription: Say what members pay and what they get. The preview at the bottom is what they are told.
fieldTierDescription: What members get, in one line
tierDescriptionHelp: One short sentence. Shown at the counter.
priceHelp: What the member pays each period.
maxMembersHelp: 1 for one person. More for a family or group.
guestPassesHelp: How many times a member can bring someone in free.
fieldIncludedProducts: What the visits can be used for
discountHelp: Taken off the normal price where it applies.
autoRenewHelp: If off, the member must buy it again.
fieldNoticeDays: Remind them this many days before
noticeDaysHelp: So members aren't charged without warning.
